common.tagline: Build anything with an AI agent that has a real computer.
common.demoModeHint: Running on mock providers — nothing is charged and no external service is called.

auth.signInSubtitle: Pick up where your agent left off.
auth.registerSubtitle: Your first sandbox is ready in about four seconds.
auth.name: Full name
auth.resetPasswordSubtitle: We'll email you a link that stays valid for one hour.
auth.resetLinkSent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.
auth.demoHint: The demo account is seeded with two projects, a sleeping sandbox and a month of usage history.
auth.passwordRules: At least 12 characters, including one number.
auth.acceptTerms: I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
auth.verifyEmailSent: We sent a verification link to {email}.
auth.verifyEmailHint: You can keep using Karo while you verify — only billing changes are blocked until you do.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.emailTaken: An account already uses this email. Sign in instead.
auth.accountSuspended: This account is suspended. Contact support to restore access.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
auth.signOutConfirm: Sign out of Karo on this device?

onboarding.title: Get your agent running
onboarding.subtitle: Five steps, about three minutes. You can leave and come back — progress is saved.
onboarding.stepCreateProjectHint: A project is a workspace, a filesystem and a sandbox that belong together.
onboarding.stepChooseRuntimeHint: Karo Cloud, your own server, or an external sandbox provider.
onboarding.stepFirstTaskHint: Try "add a health check endpoint and a test for it".
onboarding.stepReviewChangesHint: Nothing is written to your repository until you approve it.
onboarding.stepInviteTeamHint: Seats are per plan; viewers are free on every tier.
onboarding.completed: Setup complete. Your agent is live.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noActivityDescription: Create a project and give the agent its first task — the run will show up here with the exact tokens and compute it used.
dashboard.allQuiet: All quiet — no runs in the last 24 hours.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project has its own filesystem, sandbox and conversation history.
projects.deleteConfirmBody: This destroys the sandbox, the workspace filesystem and every conversation in this project. It cannot be undone.
projects.emptyDescription: A project gives the agent a place to work: files it can edit, a machine it can run commands on, and a history you can audit.
projects.limitReachedDescription: Your plan includes {limit} projects. Archive one you're finished with, or move up a plan.

chat.title: Chat
chat.placeholder: Describe what you want built. The agent can read files and run commands.
chat.modeAskHint: Answers questions and reads files. Never writes and never runs commands.
chat.modePlanHint: Investigates and proposes a plan. Waits for your approval before acting.
chat.modeBuildHint: Edits files and runs commands, pausing for approval on anything destructive.
chat.modeAutoHint: Full autonomy inside the sandbox. Still blocked from the network unless you allow it.
chat.approvalHint: The agent wants to run a command that can change things outside the workspace.
chat.emptyDescription: "Find why the checkout test is flaky and fix it" works better than "improve the tests". The agent can read the repo before it answers.
chat.failedDescription: The model provider returned an error partway through. Your files are untouched — retry to pick up from the last completed step.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.disconnectedHint: The connection dropped. Your session is still alive in the sandbox — reconnect to reattach.
terminal.emptyDescription: Open a shell inside the sandbox. Everything you type runs on the project's machine, never on Karo's servers.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: The isolated Linux machine this project runs on.
sandbox.hintStarting: Booting the machine — usually about four seconds.
sandbox.hintSleeping: Asleep to save compute. It wakes on your next command (~4s) and your files are exactly as you left them.
sandbox.hintStopped: Stopped manually. Start it again to keep working; the filesystem is preserved.
sandbox.hintFailed: The machine failed to start. Check the event log below, then recreate it — your workspace files are safe.
sandbox.hintDestroyed: This sandbox was destroyed. Create a new one to continue; files were restored from the last workspace snapshot.
sandbox.connectOwnServerHint: Run this one-liner on any Linux box with Docker. It installs the Karo worker and registers it to your team.
sandbox.emptyDescription: A sandbox is created the first time the agent needs to run something. You can also start one now to poke around the filesystem.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Model Context Protocol servers extend the agent with tools you control.
mcp.secretsHint: Values are encrypted before they're stored and are never sent to the browser again.
mcp.emptyDescription: Connect a server to give the agent tools beyond its sandbox — your issue tracker, your database, your internal APIs.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Reusable instructions the agent loads when a task matches.
skills.author: By {author}
skills.emptyDescription: Skills teach the agent your conventions once instead of every conversation — commit style, review checklist, deploy runbook.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Packaged integrations that add tools, commands and UI panels.
plugins.emptyDescription: Plugins bundle tools, slash commands and panels together — install one and it shows up in every project on this team.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Everything the agent spent, down to the individual call.
usage.weightedTokensHint: One input token equals one weighted token. Output, cached and reasoning tokens convert at the model's current price ratio.
usage.computeHoursHint: One base compute hour is 0.25 vCPU with 512 MB of RAM. Bigger machines burn the quota faster.
usage.quotaWarningDescription: At the current rate you'll run out on {date}. Top up or move up a plan before the agent stops mid-run.
usage.quotaExceededDescription: Runs are paused until the period resets on {date}. Add credit or upgrade to resume immediately.
usage.emptyDescription: Once the agent runs, every model call and compute-second lands here with its exact cost.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Plan, credit and invoices for this team.
billing.autoTopUpHint: When the balance drops below {threshold}, charge {amount} automatically.
billing.spendLimitHint: The agent stops before crossing this. You'll get a notification at 80%.
billing.checkoutDemoHint: Billing is running on the mock provider. No card is charged and no request leaves this machine.
billing.paymentRequiredDescription: The last invoice failed. Update the card on file and runs resume within a minute.
billing.emptyInvoicesDescription: Your first invoice is issued at the end of the current billing period.

plans.paygTagline: Credit that never expires. Good for spikes.
plans.liteTagline: One machine, one developer, real work.
plans.proTagline: Parallel agents and a machine that keeps up.
plans.scaleTagline: Teams shipping on the agent every day.
plans.ultraTagline: Dedicated workers and your own routing.

team.title: Team
team.description: Who can see this team's projects, and what they can do.
team.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {name}? They lose access to every project in this team immediately.
team.roleOwnerHint: Full control, including billing and deleting the team.
team.roleAdminHint: Manages members, projects and integrations. No billing.
team.roleDeveloperHint: Runs agents, edits files, opens sandboxes.
team.roleViewerHint: Reads conversations and diffs. Cannot run anything.
team.seatsFull: Every seat is taken. Free one up or add seats on the billing page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeyShownOnce: Copy this key now — it is never shown again.
settings.byokHint: Calls billed to your key still count compute, but weighted tokens stop drawing from your quota.
settings.deleteAccountWarning: Deleting your account destroys every project, sandbox and conversation you own. Team data you don't own is transferred to the team owner.
settings.saveFailedToast: Couldn't save your settings. Try again.

admin.title: Admin
admin.impersonateWarning: You are viewing Karo as {name}. Every action is recorded in the audit log.

errors.genericDescription: The request didn't complete. Retry — if it fails again, send us the code below.
errors.notFoundDescription: It may have moved or been deleted. Open your dashboard and search for it there.
errors.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this
errors.forbiddenDescription: Your role on this team doesn't include this action. A team admin can change it in team settings.
errors.unauthorizedDescription: Your session ended. Sign in again and we'll bring you straight back here.
errors.rateLimitedDescription: You've hit the rate limit for this endpoint. It clears in {seconds} seconds.
errors.offlineDescription: Karo can't reach the server. The agent keeps running in the sandbox — this page reconnects on its own.
errors.providerUnavailableDescription: Requests to {provider} are failing. Switch models in the composer, or wait — we retry automatically.
errors.quotaExceededDescription: This team has used its included weighted tokens for the period. Add credit or upgrade to keep going.
errors.paymentRequiredDescription: The last invoice couldn't be collected. Update the card on file to unblock runs.
errors.sandboxStartingDescription: Give it a few seconds. Commands sent now are queued and run as soon as it's up.
errors.sandboxSleepingDescription: It wakes on your next command, in about four seconds. Nothing was lost.
errors.sandboxFailedDescription: The machine couldn't boot. Recreate it from the sandbox panel — your workspace files are stored separately and are safe.
errors.validationDescription: Some values weren't accepted. The details are next to each field.
errors.conflictDescription: This record moved on while you were editing. Reload to see the current version, then reapply your change.

empty.noResultsDescription: Nothing matched "{query}". Try a shorter term or clear the filters.
empty.noDataDescription: This fills in as soon as there's something to show.
empty.noSelectionDescription: Pick an item on the left to see its details.
